Support Ticket Analytics Dashboard

Internship project at Ramco Systems · Python, Streamlit

⌄

The brief

Turn the ticket data of a global ERP support team (10,000+ tickets) into something the team can act on.

Tools

PythonPandasStreamlitRandom Forest

What I did

  1. Designed a weighted productivity scoring model.
  2. Built a rule-based SLA-risk system to flag at-risk tickets.
  3. Built and benchmarked 3 forecasting models (exponential smoothing, Random Forest, linear regression) with rolling-origin backtesting.
  4. Developed root-cause analysis to tell systemic issues apart from account-specific ones.

Inside the dashboard

Four tabs: Productivity, Customer Health, Recurring Issues Analysis and Predictive Analytics (forecasting and risk prediction).

  • Productivity: compares the Functional and Technical teams on productivity, SLA, response time, resolution time, reopen rate and customer satisfaction, with score-weight and ranking-threshold settings.
  • Customer tier fairness check: asks whether higher-tier customers really get better SLA compliance. In this data, tier status didn't line up neatly with service level: Silver had the lowest compliance and Platinum didn't beat Gold.
  • SLA breach risk: open tickets sorted into high, medium and low risk so the team knows what to look at first.
  • Forecast with a backtest: a weekly Holt-Winters ticket forecast with a 95% confidence band, validated over 3 rolling windows (average error 17.4% MAPE, ranging from 11.8% to 25.1% by window).

The dashboard (tap to enlarge)

Result: a production-ready dashboard with full technical documentation.

Sales & Business Performance Dashboard

Academic project · Power BI · 5 dashboard pages

⌄

The brief

Take two years of sales data (2013–2014) across 5 customer segments, 6 products and 5 countries, and show where the money comes from and where it leaks.

Tools

Power BIKPIsMatrix & trend charts

What the dashboards showed

₹118.73Mtotal sales, with ₹16.89M profit
14.23%overall profit margin (cost ratio 85.77%)
44%of all sales landed in Q4, the best quarter in both years
21.86% → 9.07%margin from no discount to the high discount band
  • Government is the biggest segment, with ₹53M in sales and 65% of total profit.
  • Enterprise runs at a negative margin (−3.13%), with a cost ratio above 100%.
  • Paseo is the most profitable product, ahead of VTT and Amarilla.
  • The deeper the discount, the lower the margin: each step up in discount band cut profitability.

The dashboards (tap to enlarge)

What I did

  • Built 5 KPI dashboards covering sales performance, executive KPIs, product trends, profitability and country-wise business insights.
  • Analyzed discount patterns and sales data to surface performance insights and business opportunities.
